title: The Castle
author: Franz Kafka
summary: A man called K. arrives in a village claiming to be the Land Surveyor summoned by the castle above it, but he cannot reach its officials or confirm his position. The novel was left unfinished.
readIf: you enjoy bureaucratic nightmares and open-ended, absurd fiction.
skipIf: you need a resolved plot, since the book breaks off mid-sentence.
